items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: AC-1..AC-8 each map to code+test: failed_only_ok/retry branch (test_suite_retry), merge (test_suite_failed_only), isolation (build_command tests), real pytest (integration). Resume ACs were cut by review and recorded in the spec.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Every doubt (no cache, count mismatch, rc 5, unmergeable report, >10 failures, INFRA) falls back to the pre-existing whole-unit retry; cancel path preserved and raises KeyboardInterrupt as before.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No new external input: reads our own pytest cache/JUnit (ET.parse of locally produced files, nosec noted), argv lists only, no shell.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Outcome-based: executed-test marker files prove ok tests ran once and red ones twice under real pytest+xdist; 3 consecutive green runs; fakes only for orchestration branches.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Narrow retry replaces a ~22 min whole-unit run for small red sets; one extra XML parse per red unit.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: run_test_suite.py 529->485 lines (bloat cap respected); new modules 128/134 lines; RETRY_* constants re-exported so existing imports hold.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: pytest cache lastfailed -> read_lastfailed and merge_junit -> Retention/stage_f0_evidence; both exercised with real pytest output in the integration test.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: scan_test_hygiene --diff: no findings; the module-level skip is guarded by a CI hard-fail.
